# Rimrock Gold Corp. Announces it is Expanding into the Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) Market  
**Filed under** [Uncategorized](https://www.rimrockgold.com/category/uncategorized/)  
Toronto April 28, 2021: Rimrock Gold Corp. (OTC Pinks: RMRK) is pleased to announce it is expanding into the NMN market with the introduction of new brand Astound NMN.  
The Companys newest brand launch and product release is driven by our long-term initiative to provide consumers with the greatest selection of wellness-centered products. Astound NMN will be added to the Companys CBD product line up, and its CBD coffee infused with the health benefits of resveratrol. The company is working diligently to build the brands ecommerce website, astoundnmn.com, which we will announce upon completion. The website will allow potential customers to discover our product offering and further explore the limitless possibilities of this innovative, age-defying supplement.
As we age, the biological mechanisms that support our youth diminish. Astound NMN products have the potential to repair DNA cells, increase metabolism, and support anti-aging. Accumulating research in nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) suggests supplementing the compound can increase nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) levels, which are responsible for many critical biological processes. Because these NAD+ levels naturally decline with age, they are linked to conditions like cardiovascular disease, neurodegenerative diseases, and cancer.  
Research performed by the University of New South Wales and Harvard University suggests that supplementing NMN has the ability to counteract the depletion of your bodys natural NAD+ levels as a result of aging. Thus, helping restore cellular energy, support healthy brain function and promote anti-aging throughout the entire body.  
The global Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) market size is expected to gain market growth in the forecast period of 2021 to 2026, with a CAGR of 7.0%% and is expected to reach USD 132.8 million by 2025, from USD 101.3 million in 2019.
We are thrilled to be adding Astound NMN to our brand portfolio. This innovative market and product aligns well with our current health and wellness focused product offering. By continuing to expand our roster, we hope to supply consumers with the options they desire based on individual needs. The way we see it, Astound NMN supplements are a seamless addition. stated Jordan Starkman, President of Rimrock Gold Corp. While we are excited for and dedicated to this new venture, our interest in the cannabis sector remains significant. Ultimately, we stay committed to the success of the Company, and will we will continue to update shareholders on our progression.
